title: Timing of a Modification Request and the Installment Count of a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Patient Financial Services policy — the count adjustment of a Patient Payment Plan modification**

(1) A count adjustment follows the timing of the request: where at least 25 calendar days have passed since the due date of the latest installment collected by automatic payment, counting that due date as day zero, and no payment holiday deferred an installment within the last 12 months, the next installment is held at the installment in force, so one installment in force is taken out of the plan balance and one installment out of the count; where a payment holiday deferred an installment within the last 12 months, each such deferred installment is added to the installments not yet due and to the modified term; otherwise the count is not adjusted.

(2) Where no installment has yet been collected by automatic payment, no installment is held.

(3) A deferred installment is placed by its due date, and lies within the last 12 months when fewer than 12 whole calendar months separate that due date from the handling date. The installment in force is the plan's current monthly installment, and the plan balance meant in clause (1) is the balance that is spread over the count.

## Judgement table

| Payment holiday deferred an installment within the last 12 months | Days since the due date of the latest installment collected by automatic payment | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| No | 25 or more | One installment in force out of the balance spread, one installment out of the count |
| No | 24 or fewer | None |
| No | No installment yet collected by automatic payment | None |
| Yes (one or more) | Any | Each deferred installment added to the installments not yet due and to the modified term |

## Hypothetical cases (installment in force 150.00)

- Latest automatic collection was for the installment due 2026-05-01; request handled 2026-05-26 (day 25); no holiday in the last 12 months. 150.00 comes out of the balance spread and one installment out of the count.
- Same, handled 2026-05-25 (day 24): no adjustment.
- One installment deferred as a payment holiday 5 months ago: one installment is added to the installments not yet due and one to the modified term, whatever the days elapsed.
